|strategy=By Sean Torrens

With just a few extra cards, [[Jeroen Webb]] can turn into his own version of the [[Tantive IV]]! Deploy "Jerry" and any UNPILOTED [[Y-wing]] ([[Gold 1]], [[Gold 2]] or [[Gold 5]]) to [[Death Star (Special Edition){{!}}Death Star]] just like the [[Tantive IV]]. Begin to Force drain like crazy, or to top it off, deploy [[Red Leader]] or [[Dutch]] to the second pilot seat and now have: power of 5 (like the [[Tantive IV]]), enough ability to draw destiny, and subtract 1 from the opponent's total battle destiny! All this for 5 Force! The same amount it takes to deploy the [[Tantive IV]]! If you deploy [[Commander Wedge Antilles]] to the second pilot seat instead of [[Red Leader]] or [[Dutch]], you can have a power of 7 and all the others nifty bonuses!
